alex.w: Heads up — marketplace GA rollout planned Thu EOD. We need final driver/CUDA/ROCm pins approved by HW partners + legal signoff for joint announcement. Who can own the technical gating?

maria.p: I can own partner comms. Need a compatibility matrix from eng. Also request a deadline: Wed 12:00 UTC for final pins.

ken.t: FYI we hit a regression on CUDA 12.2 + cuDNN 9 on A100 at scale. Repro steps in logs. Suggest we mark CUDA 12.2 as risky until patch.

ken.t: repro snippet:
```bash
# failing test
CUDA=12.2
NVIDIA_DRIVER=535.86
ROCm=5.6
python -m tests.inference --model=resnet50 --batch-size=64
```

sarah.l: Can we communicate a short compat policy to marketplace to avoid blocking listings? e.g., "supports CUDA 11.8, 12.1; 12.2 experimental"

priya.r: DevOps can schedule a canary run in dedicated env tonight. Need which image & kernel to use. @ken.t can you paste pinned image tag?

ken.t: image: redwood/inference:release-2026.03-driver535-cuda12.1
Also tests passing on 12.1. I'll open an issue for 12.2 regression: https://tracker/redwood/RED-3210

devops-bot: Canary deploy started to dedicated-canary (region-us-west1). Build: release-2026.03-driver535-cuda12.1 :rocket:

partner-ops: HW partner asked for driver-ABI matrix + rollback plan. They want a simple statement for marketing: "We validated driver X with CUDA Y on these SKUs".

maria.p: I'll draft the joint announcement blurb once matrix is final. Need signoff from security & legal after we pin.

alex.w: Next steps: Ken triages 12.2 regression (issue + patch ETA by Tue), Priya schedule canary (tonight), Maria prepares comms draft (Wed noon). If anyone can't meet, flag now.

ken.t: flagged. I'll add timeline to RED-3210.
